name: pam_aad
detailed_description: PAM module for Azure AD integration. Allows authentication against Microsoft Azure Active Directory, enabling Office 365 and cloud-based identity management in PAM-aware applications.
notes:
Requires Azure AD tenant configuration. Integrates with Office 365 and cloud services.
